spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (बणति)
To sound; better also वण.

m. (-णः)
Sound, noise.
E.
बण to sound, aff. अच्.

m. (-णः)
An arrow, &c.: see वाण.
E.
बण or वण to sound, aff. घञ्.

n. (थं)
Traffick, commerce.
E.
बणिज्, and पथ् for पथिन् a path.

m. (-त्त्रः)
The son of a merchant, or a young merchant or trader.
f. (-त्त्री)
A young woman of the same tribe.
E.
बणिज्, and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-न्धुः)
The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.)
E.
बणिज् a trader, and बन्धु the friend.

n. (-वं)
Traffick, trade, commerce.
E.
बणिज् a trader, and भाव property.

m. (-हः)
A camel.
E.
बणिज् a trader, बह who bears.

m. (-णिक)
1 A merchant, a trader.
2 The sixth of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas, corresponding to the half of a lunar day.
f. (-णिक्)
Trade, traffick.
E.
पण to transact business, इजि Uṇādi aff., and ब substituted for प.

nf. (-ज्यं-ज्या)
Trade, traffick.
E.
बणिज् a trader, य aff.

mf. (-ज्यं-ज्या)
Trade, traffic, commerce.
E.
बणिज् a trader, with ष्यञ् aff. or बाणिज् the same, aff. यत्.

m. (-रं)
The course of an arrow.
E.
बाण, and गोचर object.

The goddess of speech, &c.: see वाणि.
E.
बण or वण to speak, in the causal form, aff. इ.

m. (-जः)
1 A merchant, a trader.
2 Submarine fire.
E.
बणिज्, &c. aff. अण्.

m. (-कः)
1 Submarine fire.
2 A trader, a merchant.
3 A rogue, a cheat.
E.
बणिज trade, aff. ठञ्.
